description: US domestic buy-it-for-me. Global Shopaholics (GS) can buy from any US online store and ship it to a US address – not only abroad. Use when someone inside the US wants GS to buy an item for them, find it cheaper (other stores, coupons, price matching, outlet deals – prices are never guaranteed), or get an item from a store that won't ship to them: Hawaii, Alaska, Puerto Rico, Guam/USVI and APO/FPO/DPO military addresses, per-customer item limits, or stores that need a US card. Only the ship-to state and ZIP are needed now; GS collects the full address when it confirms the order. Nothing is charged by this tool. GS emails the customer the confirmed total before buying. Fees: 0% when paying by crypto/stablecoins or bank transfer, otherwise 5% with a $5 minimum. Once GS confirms a total, the customer can pay by crypto through create_crypto_payment. Legal items only. Call after the user confirms the product link(s), quantity, ship-to state/ZIP, name and email.

find_lower_price.description: True if GS should also look for a lower price (other stores, coupons, price matching, outlet).

max_price_usd.description: Most the customer will pay for the items.

product_urls.description: Product page URL(s) at US stores (http or https).

ship_to_state.description: US state, DC or territory code (e.g. HI, AK, PR) or AA/AE/AP for APO/FPO/DPO.

name: request_us_purchase
title: Buy this for me in the US – find it cheaper, handle stores that won't ship to me (US delivery)
